description: This PHP class ContentPage belongs to a documentation system, responsible for generating content pages such as handling breadcrumb trails, language settings, homepage detection, and rendering templates based on the page context within a hierarchical directory structure.

classes.name: ContentPage
classes.description: A class responsible for rendering and managing individual content pages in a documentation site, including breadcrumb navigation, language support, and template selection.

methods.name: isHomepage
methods.description: Determines whether the current page is the homepage based on directory structure.

methods.name: isLanding
methods.description: Checks if the current page is a landing page based on configuration and page context.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes page-specific variables such as language and homepage status.

methods.name: getBreadcrumbTrail
methods.description: Generates the breadcrumb trail array based on parent directories, supporting multilanguage configurations.

methods.name: generatePage
methods.description: Prepares page data and calls the template renderer to produce the final page HTML.
